breaking_news.headline: Tired of leaks, the Trump administration wants federal workers to sign NDAs
breaking_news.summary: The Trump administration has proposed creating a new government-wide nondisclosure agreement for new and existing federal employees.

breaking_news.headline: More people are going hungry now than at the height of the pandemic
breaking_news.summary: Food insecurity affects more families now than during the coronavirus pandemic, according to a new survey from the Federal Reserve Bank of New York.

breaking_news.headline: NPR's newsroom shrinks through buyouts and layoffs
breaking_news.summary: At least 18 NPR journalists have accepted buyouts and another 10 have been laid off as the public media network attempts to save money and reorganize the newsroom.

breaking_news.headline: DOJ charges Google staffer over Polymarket trades netting $1.2 million
breaking_news.summary: It's the second known case of the federal government filing criminal charges against someone who allegedly used insider information to make a large profit on a prediction market site.

breaking_news.headline: Ferrari unveiled its first EV model. The response has been lukewarm
breaking_news.summary: NPR's Steve Inskeep speaks to Mack Hogan of Inside EVs about the lukewarm consumer response to Ferrari's first electric vehicle.

breaking_news.headline: Trump wants a gas tax holiday. There's a much bigger problem looming
breaking_news.summary: Suspending the federal gasoline tax could save drivers up to 18.4 cents per gallon. But it would drain the fund meant to cover roadbuilding and repairs — a fund that's already in trouble.

breaking_news.headline: These swing voters are adding high gas prices into their political calculations
breaking_news.summary: As part of NPR's Swing Shift project checking in with swing voters, these Americans are split on who is to blame for high gas prices but they all agree it has an impact on their personal finances.

breaking_news.headline: This is how close American households are to the financial edge
breaking_news.summary: A new report shows that nearly half of U.S. households did not earn enough to cover their necessities in 2024.

breaking_news.headline: Sixteen pupils killed in Kenya school fire
breaking_news.summary: Dozens of people were also injured in the fire, the cause of which is not yet known.

breaking_news.headline: US justice department launches criminal investigation into Trump accuser E Jean Carroll
breaking_news.summary: The case centres on whether the former columnist lied about the funding she received for her civil lawsuit against the US president.

breaking_news.headline: Man arrested after three injured in stabbing at Swiss train station
breaking_news.summary: The suspect, a 31-year-old Swiss man, has been arrested, police say, as areas around the station are cordoned off.

breaking_news.headline: Villas, cars and cash: Italy seizes dead Mafia mobster's millions
breaking_news.summary: Police say the operation targeted the network of notorious late Sicilian mafia boss Matteo Messina Denaro.

breaking_news.headline: Israel hits Lebanese capital in 'targeted strike'
breaking_news.summary: Beirut had until now largely been spared even as both Israel and Hezbollah accused each other of breaking last month's ceasefire.

breaking_news.headline: Iran says it targeted American base after fresh US strikes
breaking_news.summary: The hostilities come during a fragile ceasefire between the US and Iran, and protracted negotiations to end the three-month war.

breaking_news.headline: Are US and Iran close to peace or sliding back to war?
breaking_news.summary: Neither side seems interested in a return to all-out conflict, despite the latest exchange of strikes.

breaking_news.headline: Gaza City hospitals say several killed in strike, as Israel targets Hamas leaders
breaking_news.summary: At least five children were reportedly killed in the strike, which appears to have targeted a Hamas commander.

breaking_news.headline: How you can save money on your energy bill
breaking_news.summary: Experts say action now can save money when the pinch comes this winter.

breaking_news.headline: Oil prices fall after report of breakthrough in US-Iran talks
breaking_news.summary: A report of a extended ceasefire, subject to Donald Trump's approval, has led to global oil prices to fall on Thursday.

breaking_news.headline: EU fines Temu €200m for allowing sale of illegal products
breaking_news.summary: The European Commission says the Chinese-owned online retailer failed to take account of risks from baby toys and faulty chargers sold on its platform.

breaking_news.headline: Is 'out of control' US tipping culture spreading overseas?
breaking_news.summary: With US waiting staff getting cross at receiving less than 20%, tips are also on the rise elsewhere.
